messages:
Maya P.: quick check — are we confident the observability phase-gate is green for the console rollout next week? specifically: dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and the 90/30 retention sweep?

Jon K.: Depends on storage signoff. Dashboards mostly ready, dave pushed the main panels yesterday. Tracing hooks still waiting on the agent bump.

Dave L.: Dashboard PR is here: https://git.internal/r/redwood/obs-console/pulls/412 — most panels use the new metrics schema, only the user-activity panel needs a mapping tweak. I can patch it ytd.

Anya S.: From SRE side we need retention validated. The retention migration script needs a dry run against staging logs to confirm no spikes. Sam, can storage accommodate the extra hot-days for the dry run? :eyes:

Sam R.: We can run a dry run but need a window — prefer Tue night (0200-0400 UTC) to minimize impact. Also need the retention config blob from you, Anya.

Anya S.: copying config below (staging values). please confirm you can apply before Tue.

Anya S.: ```yaml
traces:
  hot_days: 7
  warm_days: 23
  cold_days: 60
metrics:
  hot_days: 30
  retention_tier: standard
```

Sam R.: ok can do Tue 02:00 UTC. Will run dry-run and share stats (ingest rate, storage growth, query latency).

Maya P.: thanks. Ownership check: dashboards -> Dave, tracing hooks -> Jon, retention + dry run -> Sam + Anya, rollout approvals -> Maya + EngPlatform leads. Is everyone aligned?

Jon K.: aligned. For tracing hooks: I opened a small agent PR that adds the sampling tag and hook points — https://git.internal/r/redwood/agent/pulls/88. Need infra to cut a canary after merge.

infra-bot: canary pipeline queued: https://ci.internal/pipelines/obs-canary-2021-88 — triggered on merge to canary branch.

Dave L.: note: error-analysis view still lacks grouped stack traces for lambda cold starts. I have a patch but it depends on the agent PR to attach execution-id. If the canary is delayed, we should still rollout dashboards behind a feature flag.

Maya P.: good call. Let's gate dashboards behind feature flag and enable for internal teams only until canary completes. Action items:
- Jon: land agent PR + ping infra to run canary (due Mon EOD)
- Sam + Anya: run retention dry-run Tue 02:00 UTC, post results in this thread (due Tue 08:00 UTC)
- Dave: patch user-activity mapping + error-analysis grouping (feature-flagged) (due Wed)
- Maya: signoff once retention and canary results look good

Jon K.: will push agent PR updates today. tagging @infra to please prioritize canary when ready.

Sam R.: added to calendar. I'll post the result artifacts and a short TL;DR.

Dave L.: starting mapping patch now, will open a PR with a short test plan.

Maya P.: perfect. if any blockers, @here call it out. otherwise we'll plan a soft rollout Thurs morning limited to internal accounts. :shipit:
